articles.text: Does Geopolitics and New Gas Projects Change The Bull Case For Chevron (CVX)?. In recent days, Chevron has been in focus as U.S.-Iran tensions pushed Brent crude above US$90 a barrel, while analysts highlighted the potential for stronger near-term earnings and gas price increases amid ongoing military strikes and supply concerns. At the same time, Chevron has been testing new energy-adjacent avenues such as powering Microsoft’s West Texas AI data center with natural gas turbines and exploring major Iraqi oilfield and export projects that could diversify its operational...
